v3.note: V3 support is DuckLauncherArc-only (registered via addDexV3). DuckIncubationArc/DuckRaiseArc are V4-only.

fees.note: All native-currency-denominated (native gas on Arc is USDC, 18-decimal precision) -- 1 USDC creation/launch/campaign fee, 50 USDC CTO fee.

v3LockerFees.note: DuckLockerArc's V3-only fee config (see notes below -- these were all 0 on the live proxy until fixed post-deploy via owner calls; the 50/50-split/50-USDC values shown here are the corrected, currently-live state).

arcInfrastructure.note: Arc has no WETH. Native gas IS USDC (18-decimal). The ERC20 mirror above is a DIFFERENT precision from native (6 decimals, standard USDC convention, confirmed live via cast on 2026-09-03: name()/symbol() both "USDC", real nonzero totalSupply -- an earlier note here calling it 18-decimal/unverified was a guess made before the RPC's rate limiting cleared, now corrected). As of 2026-09-03 it's seeded as DuckLauncherArc's first real quote token (owner call: addQuoteToken(0x3600...)) -- the only ERC20 currently allowed there; native currency remains the only V4 quote option otherwise, and V3 requires this (or a future real quote asset) since it forbids native entirely.

notes: IMPORTANT -- cross-chain address collision (expected, not a bug): the deployer EOA (0x43977b10095Fc5E153F907fe2E888C083fA4Fb66) landed on the same nonce sequence on Arc as it originally used on Ink, and plain CREATE addresses depend only on (deployer, nonce), not chain ID. As a result several Arc addresses are byte-for-byte identical STRINGS to Ink addresses: DuckLauncherArc/DuckLockerArc proxies and all three token impls match their live Ink counterparts exactly; DuckIncubationArc/DuckRaiseArc proxies match Ink's now-retired v1 (pre-2026-09-03-redeploy) proxy addresses. These are fully separate, chain-scoped contracts -- the identical strings do not mean anything is shared or misconfigured -- but never cross-paste an address between Ink and Arc configs without checking the chain ID field first.

No quote tokens or routes are seeded by this deploy (Arc has no verified default assets yet, unlike Ink's original 15-address seed list which was also removed as part of the 2026-09-03 Ink size-limit fix). Add real Arc quote assets via setQuoteTokenAllowed/setRoutes/addQuoteToken before real trading can happen.
Owner and platformWallet are the same deployer EOA / treasury wallet already used on Ink. Consider a timelock/multisig before real volume flows through this.

As of 2026-09-03: a subgraph is live (self-hosted graph-node, since Goldsky only supports arc-testnet, a different chain -- see Duck-Family's subgraph-arc/README.md), the backend API serves /arc/... routes alongside /ink/..., and the interface has a real Ink/Arc chain switcher plus a V4/V3 dex selector on the instant-launch form (V3 is DuckLauncherArc-only).

Two post-deploy config bugs found and fixed (2026-09-03), both owner-only calls, no redeploy needed: (1) DuckHookV4Arc.platformWallet was never set (the Deploy.s.sol script had no call for it -- unlike the proxy contracts, which take platformWallet as an initialize() param, the hook is deployed via DuckHookFactory with no such param) -- fixed via setPlatformWallet. (2) DuckLockerArc's v3TokenBurnBps/v3QuoteCreatorBps/v3CtoFee were inline field initializers in the source, which only ever apply to a UUPS implementation's own throwaway storage, never a real proxy's -- all three read 0 on the live proxy (V3 CTO effectively free, V3 LP fees 100%-to-creator/100%-to-platform instead of the intended 50/50 split) until fixed via setV3TokenBurnBps/setV3QuoteCreatorBps/setV3CtoFee. Source fixed to set these in initialize() instead, so a future fresh deploy doesn't repeat it.

Verified post-deploy via cast: owner/platformWallet/creationFee/launchFee/campaignFee/ctoFee all read back correctly on every contract; DuckHookV4Arc has V3 support wired on DuckLauncherArc only (addDexV3), DuckIncubationArc/DuckRaiseArc stay V4-only as specified.
